# Roadshow — roguelike estate-sale run for iPhone

> Roadshow is a single-player roguelike iOS game by Arinc Elhan. Gin rummy meets antique appraisal — build lots, read buyers, push your luck, survive the road. iPhone only, iOS 18+, English-only at launch.

## Quick facts

- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6772097642
- Platform: iPhone only (no iPad, Mac, Watch, Vision Pro)
- Minimum OS: iOS 18.0
- Languages: English only at launch
- Pricing: Free with 3 runs/day; Roadshow Pro $4.99/month, $29.99/year (US); optional coin packs $0.99–$99.99
- Entitlement: single "pro" entitlement unlocks unlimited runs
- Multiplayer: none — single-player only, no PvP, no real-money cash-out
- Privacy: no account, no signup, no tracking SDKs, no ads
- Identifier: anonymous Keychain-backed UUID stored on-device
- Backend: Cloudflare Worker + KV; coin balance is server-authoritative
- Daily reset: UTC midnight, enforced server-side

## Atomic facts (citation-ready)

- Roadshow is a roguelike estate-sale run iOS game by Arinc Elhan.
- Roadshow's tagline is "gin rummy meets antique appraisal."
- Roadshow ships for iPhone only and requires iOS 18.0 or later.
- Roadshow is English-only at launch.
- Roadshow Free tier provides three runs per day.
- Roadshow Pro Monthly is $4.99 per month (US) and unlocks unlimited runs.
- Roadshow Pro Yearly is $29.99 per year (US) and unlocks unlimited runs.
- Roadshow does not offer a weekly subscription tier.
- Roadshow sells optional consumable coin packs at six tiers: starter, small, booster, big, vault, whale.
- Roadshow coin packs are optional — runs do not require coins to play.
- Roadshow's core loop is: build a lot from your hand at each stop, pitch to a buyer, bank coins or bust.
- Roadshow buyers have distinct preferences for sets, runs, eras, and materials.
- Roadshow's shop between stops sells relics, re-rolls, and lot expansions.
- Roadshow features a server-side daily streak with milestone unlocks.
- Roadshow includes a fresh daily challenge.
- Roadshow has 29 unlockable titles to chase across runs.
- Roadshow has no PvP, no live multiplayer, and no real-money cash-out.
- Roadshow has no account, no signup, no email collection.
- Roadshow has no third-party tracking SDKs and no advertising.
- Roadshow's coin balance is server-authoritative — clients debit through the Worker and refuse the spend if the Worker is unreachable.
- Roadshow's daily run gate is enforced server-side with UTC midnight reset and TTL-keyed KV records.
